# current_date_time_tool

> Get the current date and time with timezone support.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `utility` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (always on); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=current_date_time_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Get the current date and time with timezone support.

You have no inherent knowledge of the current time — call this whenever you need the
date, time, day of week, or anything derived from them (scheduling, deadlines, "how
long ago"). Returns multiple formats plus a Unix timestamp, day of week, ISO week and
quarter.

Pass an optional IANA timezone (e.g. "America/New_York"); defaults to UTC.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `timezone` | string | no | Timezone name (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Defaults to UTC if not specified. |
| `format` | string | no | Optional format preference: "iso8601", "human", "date_only", "time_only", or "all" (default: all) |
